body.statement:
In the unrestricted two-arm finite-population game, where the infimum ranges over every assignment mechanism and estimator, the binary value is \(\rho_n^\star\); for every fixed finite pair \(L<U\), the bounded-endpoint value is \((U-L)^2\rho_n^\star\); and
\[
\rho_n^\star=\frac1n-C_An^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}).
\]

source.locator: arXiv:2608.13822v1, Theorems 2.1--2.3 and 3.1, equations (6), (7), (9), and the display at lines 130--134 of the arXiv HTML

attestation.note: Checked directly against the primary arXiv v1 HTML on 2026-09-09. Theorem 2.1 identifies the two reduced risks, Theorem 2.2 carries the unrestricted binary equality, Theorem 2.3 the bounded-endpoint scaling, and Theorem 3.1 the Airy expansion; this corrects the directive's attribution of all three headline facts to Theorems 2.2--2.3 alone.
